parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the results to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no **Overview** page or ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page. Default value: 10.

sub_parameters.name: TagKey
sub_parameters.description: The key of the group tag.

sub_parameters.name: TagValue
sub_parameters.description: The value of the group tag.
